About the model

Original geometry interpreted from one photograph. Dimensions, track topology, and hidden areas are approximate. Includes separate chassis, body panels, bucket seat, axle pivots, slicks, alloy rims, controls, steering, fuel tank, brakes, chain and sprockets, finned engine, and exhaust.

The Blender source preserves procedural material grain and the editable component origins.
